name: isp-default-resolvers
shows: an A query asked by six probes through their own default resolvers: private ISP resolvers with the remaining TTL of their caches (one still on the old address), a probe that uses Google Public DNS, a resolver that timed out, a cached NXDOMAIN with its SOA, a probe still asking
scrubbed: hand-trimmed in the shape of a live measurement of 2026-10-08 (no resolver given): names → www.example.com / example.com, addresses → 192.0.2.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24; masked dig SERVER lines as Globalping sends them for a private resolver
